description: This PHP source file contains utility functions related to handling attachments in the TestLink project, including functions to retrieve attachment information, store attachments in session, validate attachment IDs, manage file uploads, and delete attachments.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: A generic PHP class used to instantiate objects with dynamic properties, used here for representing upload operation results.

methods.name: getAttachmentInfos
methods.description: Retrieves attachment info for a specific object via the attachment repository, optionally storing the result in session.

methods.name: getAttachmentInfosFrom
methods.description: Fetches attachment info from an object that implements getAttachmentInfos, optionally storing in session.

methods.name: storeAttachmentsInSession
methods.description: Stores attachment information array into PHP session, optionally appending to existing session data.

methods.name: checkAttachmentID
methods.description: Validates if a given attachment ID exists in the session-stored attachment info.

methods.name: fileUploadManagement
methods.description: Handles the file upload process, creating attachment records via repository, and logging events.

methods.name: deleteAttachment
methods.description: Deletes an attachment record after session validation, and logs the deletion event.
